name: Fire Emblem Engage dual screen
_about: D2 War layout (approved 2026-10-29): two bottom tabs (War|Somniel|World Map by scene, Units|Roster); War modes All (44 px map + unit card, 4 swipe pages), Map (60 px map, legend, Danger plate) and Char (Details, Engage, Bond; overview without a selection); Matchup only in the attack phase (native forecast open, then the combat). Text in the game font and art from the player's own romfs, decoded at runtime by the module (fee_font, fee_sprites); map taps inspect only. The module block is injected by tools/build_dualscreen_package.py.
_contract: Module outputs: fee.ready/mode/page/danger; war.mode/cardp/charp/ready/turn/force/c0-c2/mapkey; war.u{i}.* (lv hp mhp low engaged showeng name job face hasface ring hasring engimg); war.cm{k}.* commanders; war.sel + war.s.* (stats, combat stats with calcok, items it{k}/ni{k}/eq, skills sk{k}/es{k}, Engage weapons ew{k}, engatk, terrain ter.name/ok, sprite keys). Actions: ui_open, war_mode, war_danger, war_select, war_pick (second tap opens Char), war_card / war_charp (+1/-1, 100+n), war_pan / war_pinch (map gestures, war.view 1 = user camera), war_view (reset to follow). The native map cursor drives war.sel when it lands on a unit.
